description: Read the Timeline plugin's whole animation state: transport (playing, current time, duration, frame rate) and every interpolable — one animatable property bound to one scene object — with its keyframes. This is the read-back for every other studio_timeline_* tool. Timeline is an optional third-party plugin (joan6694): when it is not installed the call still succeeds and answers 'available': false with the reason, so check that (or 'plugins.timeline' in studio_get_info) before building an animation. Keyframe values are typed by their interpolable: numbers, booleans, [x,y,z] for positions, euler degrees for rotations, [r,g,b,a] for colours, {group,category,no} for animations. Values whose type has no JSON form come back as a string.

object_id.description: only return the interpolables bound to this scene object (id from studio_list_objects); counts still cover the whole timeline

include_keyframes.description: set false for the transport and the interpolable list without their keyframes

available.description: false when the Timeline plugin is absent or has not initialised; every other timeline tool then fails

unavailable.description: why the bridge is unavailable, null when it works

frame_rate.description: the frame rate next_frame and previous_frame step by

interpolable_count.description: over the whole timeline, before any object_id filter

keyframe_count.description: over the whole timeline, before any object_id filter

id.description: pass this to the keyframe tools

owner.description: the plugin that publishes this property; 'Timeline' for the built-in ones

name.description: the label Timeline shows, target included

object_id.description: the scene object this is bound to; null for the global properties (camera, time scale)

target.description: the bone or IK target it animates, for the per-target properties

curve.description: easing as [time, value, in_tangent, out_tangent] points; a null tangent is an infinite one
